title: eis-ui-render meta.json
description: UI declaration consumed by the eis-ui-render UIRender component. A meta.json file is a single root Field node; every node may nest further nodes under `items`. The schema is deliberately open: nodes accept properties beyond the ones listed here, because component props are forwarded to the underlying React component. Constraints are only declared where the engine genuinely requires them — every one of them corresponds to a verified runtime failure, and the shipped test suite validates all bundled examples against this file.

$schema.description: OPTIONAL pointer to this schema, e.g. "./node_modules/eis-ui-render/meta.schema.json". Editors pick up validation and autocomplete from it with no workspace configuration. The engine strips the field before rendering, so it costs nothing at runtime.

metaVersion.description: OPTIONAL contract version this file was authored against, as `MAJOR` or `MAJOR.MINOR` (current: "1"). Root-level only. Absence means "current": the file targets whatever contract the installed eis-ui-render implements, which is the right choice when meta and library ship together. MAJOR changes only for a change that would break existing meta; MINOR for additive ones. The engine ignores the value and strips the field before rendering, so declaring it never changes output.

node.description: A Field node. `view` selects the React component; `items` nests children.

name.description: Dot/bracket key path into data.json (or into the node's inherited relative data). Curly braces interpolate dynamic state, e.g. "plan.{state.plan,0}.title". MUST be a string: the engine interpolates it with String.prototype.replace, so any other type throws during render.

items.description: Nested child nodes. MUST be an array: the engine maps over it, so any other type throws during render.

relativeData.description: false makes `name` resolve against the root data.json instead of the inherited local data. Inherited by descendants; a descendant may opt back in with true.

showIf.description: Conditional rendering. A string is a key path that must be truthy. An object narrows it: {name, equal, relativeData}; an empty object tests the node's own local data.

headers.description: Table column definitions, each a node-shaped object (`id`, `label`, `renderCell`, ...). MUST be an array: the Table component maps over it.

extraHeaders.description: Additional Table column definitions appended after `headers`. MUST be an array.

extraItems.description: Additional Table rows appended after the data rows. MUST be an array.

meta.description: Nested UIRender declaration. The engine does not transform this subtree — the nested instance validates and renders it on its own — so it is a complete meta document, including its own optional `metaVersion`.

type.description: Input variant. `select`, `slider`, `toggle` and `file` re-resolve an Input node to the matching field component; `number` and `date` select the numeric and date field. Any other value is passed through to the underlying input element.

format.description: Name of a value normalizer applied when displaying the field value.

normalize.description: Name of a value normalizer applied to the field value on change.

parse.description: Name of a value parser (falls back to the normalizer of the same name) applied when reading the field value back.

validate.description: Field validation. A string names a built-in validator. Any other shape is forwarded to the form library unchanged.

verify.description: Cross-field validation, composed ahead of `validate`. `validate` here is one {name, args} definition or a list of them; remaining properties are passed to each validator as options.

validate.description: One cross-field validator definition, or a list of them.

mapOptions.description: Maps raw option objects to the {text, value} shape a Select/Dropdown needs. A string picks that single key path; an object maps target prop -> source key path, where the literal "{index}" yields the option's array index as a string.

mapItems.description: Maps raw data rows to the shape a chart needs, in the same form as `mapOptions`.

filterItems.description: Row filter definitions applied to the node's collection.

tooltip.description: Wraps the rendered node in a tooltip. A string is the tooltip title; an object is passed to the tooltip component.

styles.description: CSS class names. Transformed into `className` before rendering; the object form is the single-key value transform.

label.description: Visible label. The object form is the single-key value transform.

children.description: Literal content for text-like views, used when the node declares no `items`.

tab.description: Tabs item header: a string, or a node rendered as the tab header.

content.description: Tabs / ProgressSteps item body: a node rendered lazily when the item becomes active.

metaVersion.description: Only meaningful on the root node. The engine strips it everywhere; on a nested node it is silently ignored.

nodeEntry.description: An entry in a node collection. `null` is allowed because the engine deletes null attributes and filters null array entries before rendering, so a null entry is dropped rather than rendered.

name.description: Key path whose value is tested. Supports {state.x} interpolation.

equal.description: When present, the value at `name` must deep-equal this. When absent, the value must be truthy.

relativeData.description: false resolves `name` against the root data instead of the inherited local data.

renderer.description: A `render*` value transform. A string names a built-in render method (unknown names fall back to plain text). An object is either a nested field definition (has `view`), a function definition (has `name`), or a value-match map (has `values`).

functionRef.description: A handler. A string names a built-in action, a host-supplied `methods` entry or a renderer instance method, with comma-separated trailing arguments (e.g. "setState,active.plan"). The object form adds arguments and chaining.

args.description: Extra arguments appended after the caller's own arguments. Strings containing curly braces are interpolated with the current row index and value.

mapArgs.description: Replaces the caller's arguments with values interpolated from them and from data.json.

onDone.description: Chained handler invoked with the result (awaited when the result is a Promise).

stringOrValueRef.description: A class-name value. Passed to `classNames()`, which accepts a string or number, an array of those (recursively), an object whose truthy keys are used, or null.

valueRef.description: Single-key value transform: replaced by the value found at `name` before rendering.

view.description: Component type. The listed values are the vocabulary the engine declares; an unlisted string is accepted by this schema but renders a "field does not exist" placeholder, so the dev-mode validator reports it.

renderMethodName.description: Built-in value renderer. An unlisted string is accepted here but falls back to plain text at runtime, so the dev-mode validator reports it.

actionName.description: Built-in action. Host applications extend this set through the `methods` prop, so an unlisted string is valid.

normalizerName.description: Built-in value normalizer / parser. An unlisted string leaves the value untouched.
